text: The Nihilist transposition writes the text into a full square and reorders its rows and columns by one key. 97 is three short of 100, so a 10 by 10 square with three empty squares.
Every one of the 10! orders, eight places for the empty squares, read by rows or by columns, both directions: 116,121,600 routes, each with a repeating key on the sculpture's tables after or before.
Shortest key that fits K4: 20 after, 24 before (copies 18, 17); K4 leads the copies in 0 of 52 cells.
